items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: And I was fortunate enough to be able to sit next and listen to them live... And Pops is on the show one day... And I got to hang out with Pops, with Satchmo, with Louis Armstrong all day.

ctx.x: Of course. That’s from, once again, playing all different styles and listening, you have to listen. You listen to records, listen to the radio, you’ve got to listen to what’s going on. And I listened to Sweets, like I said, you know, somebody would say well I want you to play like Sweets, I want you to play like Miles. I had it in my head. It was in there. All the motors were in there that had all that information in the computer you know? It was all in here. And I just had to pull it out and say okay, I know…

Yeah. Pearly Mae. She was fantastic. And she had a show at the Hollywood Palace and the band was Louie’s big band and I was in it and Sweets was in it and Conte Candoli and John Audino was the trumpet section. And Pops is on the show one day. Actually it was two dates, one day of rehearsal and one day for recording. And Sweets knew Pops © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
